items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I used to play with his daddy.

ctx.x: I was talking to Saeed. It was what, it was Sam? Wasn't it Sam? I can't remember all the brothers. Neither me.
But I remember, I remember one of the brothers. He died. He died. A lot of those guys died. He used to play around. He used to play at the Preservation. He died too. I used to play with his daddy.
